scope: Ordinary source hygiene and fixture-data review only. Regex observations supplement manual review; absence of a signature alone cannot establish security. No isolation, escape, credential-exposure, Docker, provider, or hosted runtime experiment was performed.
raw_index_scope: Raw observations only, excluding reviewer verdicts. Shared fixtures retain their original provenance and exact matching canonical-byte bindings. Full configured grading/workload, app reward discrimination/ranking and target/Oracle scores are absent.

seed_string_fields.value: Starting roster exported from the comp desk. The rates, thresholds, caps and vocabulary behind these figures are written up in /instructions/hireops_rules.md; the constants block below is the machine-readable copy of them.
